description.value: A quiet, shaded municipal campground inside KP Park, two blocks off Highway 6, with hot showers, a playground, and BMX track — within easy walking distance of Salmo's downtown; open mid-May to early September at $20/night, first-come basis.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the Village of Salmo website's campground section, which explicitly describes the site's location, facilities, and occupancy policy. The website confirms showers ('washroom and hot shower facilities'), a gazebo/covered shelter in KP Park, walking access to downtown (food nearby), and explicitly states first-come, first-serve occupancy (no reservations). No phone number or street address appears in OSM or the website content.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on the website.
No street address present in OSM; website provides only directional guidance (off 2nd Street from Highway 6).
Campground is seasonal (mid May to early September); listings should note this limitation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating municipal campground with showers, covered shelter, and walkable downtown access — a solid stopover for touring cyclists on the Highway 6 corridor through the Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: Camp host on site collects fees and can answer questions. Further information available on bulletin board at the campground.

wow_evidence: hot showers… within easy walking distance of Salmo's downtown
